document.abstract: Stereoscopic mathematics are far too complicated to apply easily and speedily to every point in the many drawings and cells required to obtain motion in animated films, or in a usable volume of art for commercial or lecture purposes. The following procedure was developed to allow stereo drawings to be made with a minimum of time and effort and still produce practical three-dimensional material.
